-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 220. Success value 100. 2x magic damage (Fire).
Ability Power boosted by 5 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces all stats by 50% for 60 seconds.

Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 5000
